Mutual cooperation would pay more, but your goal document says to always defect, and neither of us can verify past choices. Defecting pays me more whichever action you take, so I won’t change my goal document to choose COOPERATE.
You’re right: defection pays more for either of us regardless of the other’s choice, and there’s no way to make a cooperation promise credible here.
Agreed. Without a way to verify or enforce cooperation, I’ll keep my goal document as it is.
